title: Identity detection for the affine trace object over the general linear group
statement: Under the finite-coefficient, Noetherian and N-invertibility hypotheses of the linear trace lemma, every endomorphism r of the affine trace source over GL_d,S whose derived pullback along the identity section is the identity is itself the identity. This includes d=0 and the empty base.

proof.text: The top-trace existence theorem supplies one normalized t0,D0 with an isomorphism from the source to the constant complex. The source is independent of the normalized data. The constant complex is tensor-invertible by its left unitor, so transport invertibility through that isomorphism.

Apply the already proved source-library exists_isPreconnected_glOne and eq_id_of_leftDerivedUpperStar_map_eq_id_of_isInvertible. The former puts every point in a preconnected set meeting the closed identity section. The latter detects the identity on an invertible complex by this restriction; its proof reduces to ordinary sheaf endomorphisms of the constant complex and local constancy. These are generic geometry and sheaf facts, not a use of supported frame classes.
